_comment: The x86 acquisition host, captured from this machine by bin/host_facts.py so every host fact in the paper is regenerable rather than typed.
doitm: not read: /dev/cpu/N/msr requires elevated privileges, not taken here

_frequency_sample_khz.note: sampled at capture time on the pinned core, idle; not pinned; varies between captures by design and is not compared by --check

kernel.note: A distribution kernel upgrade on the acquisition machine, after every committed dump was acquired. The kernel field above is the one the measurements were taken under and is what the paper prints, so it is not re-captured. bin/host_facts.py --check excuses this field only while this host reads exactly the value here; a further change fails the control.
